metadata.title: बुबाग्रा को ग़ुस्सा क्यों आया | Why Bubagra is angry with Amit Shah | Tribals of Tripura
metadata.description: Pradyot Kishor Manikya, the royal scion of Tripura and leader of the Tipra Motha, has expressed his growing frustration with the BJP leadership and Union Home Minister Amit Shah. In this exclusive interview, he makes it clear that the Indigenous people of Tripura will not wait endlessly for the implementation of the Tiprasa Accord, which was signed with much hope and promise. Pradyot warns that delaying the accord is not just a betrayal of trust but also an injustice to the tribal communities who have been waiting for constitutional and political safeguards. He urges the central leadership to act decisively and respect the aspirations of Tripura’s Indigenous population. This candid conversation reflects the rising restlessness among tribals and the mounting pressure on the government to deliver.
